```{r libraries_setup}
# ===========================
# Load required libraries
# ===========================
library(fgsea)
library(msigdbr)
library(limma)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)

# ===========================
# Output directory for GSEA
# ===========================
output_dir <- "C:/Users/socla/Documents/results"
gsea_dir   <- "C:/Users/socla/Documents/results/GSEA"
```

```{r GSEA}
# ===========================
# Prepare gene expression matrix (genes x samples)
# Use log2 normalized values, samples ordered by Codi_Noray
# ===========================
expr_mat_gsea <- db_completa_log2 %>%
  dplyr::select(Codi_Noray, starts_with("Endogenous_")) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "Codi_Noray") %>%
  as.matrix() %>%
  t()  # genes x samples

# Clean gene names: remove "Endogenous_" prefix AND "_NM_/_NR_/_XM_..." RefSeq suffix
rownames(expr_mat_gsea) <- gsub("^Endogenous_", "", rownames(expr_mat_gsea))
rownames(expr_mat_gsea) <- gsub("_(NM|NR|XM|XR|NP)_.*$", "", rownames(expr_mat_gsea))

# Collapse duplicates if any (same HUGO symbol with multiple RefSeq IDs)
if (any(duplicated(rownames(expr_mat_gsea)))) {
  expr_mat_gsea <- limma::avereps(expr_mat_gsea, ID = rownames(expr_mat_gsea))
}

cat(sprintf("Genes after cleaning: %d\n", nrow(expr_mat_gsea)))

# ===========================
# Build pSTAT3 categorical variable (same cutoffs as heatmap)
# ===========================
clin_gsea <- db_completa_log2 %>%
  dplyr::select(Codi_Noray, pSTAT3_Histoscore, PDL1) %>%
  mutate(
    pSTAT3_cat = cut(
      pSTAT3_Histoscore,
      breaks = c(-Inf, 29, 73, Inf),
      labels = c("low", "intermediate", "high"),
      right  = TRUE
    )
  )

# Remove samples with missing pSTAT3
clin_gsea <- clin_gsea %>% filter(!is.na(pSTAT3_cat))

# ===========================
# Load MSigDB gene sets: Hallmark + C2 canonical pathways
# Updated for msigdbr >= 10.0.0
# ===========================
msig_h  <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "H")
msig_c2 <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "C2") %>%
  filter(grepl("^CP:", gs_subcollection))

msig_all <- bind_rows(msig_h, msig_c2)

# Build named list: pathway -> gene symbols
gene_col <- if ("gene_symbol" %in% colnames(msig_all)) "gene_symbol" else "human_gene_symbol"
pathways_list <- split(msig_all[[gene_col]], msig_all$gs_name)
pathways_list <- lapply(pathways_list, unique)

cat(sprintf("Pathways loaded: %d (Hallmark + C2:CP)\n", length(pathways_list)))

# ===========================
# Helper function: run limma + fgsea for a given comparison
# ===========================
run_gsea_comparison <- function(expr, clin, group_var, contrast_label,
                                pathways, out_prefix) {

  # Subset expression matrix to samples available in clin
  samples_keep <- intersect(colnames(expr), clin$Codi_Noray)
  expr_sub <- expr[, samples_keep, drop = FALSE]
  clin_sub <- clin %>% filter(Codi_Noray %in% samples_keep)
  clin_sub <- clin_sub[match(colnames(expr_sub), clin_sub$Codi_Noray), ]

  group <- factor(clin_sub[[group_var]])

  # Need at least 2 samples per group
  tab <- table(group)
  cat(sprintf("\n--- %s ---\n", contrast_label))
  print(tab)
  if (any(tab < 2) || length(levels(group)) < 2) {
    cat("Not enough samples per group. Skipping.\n")
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Design matrix: group2 vs group1 (reference = first level)
  design <- model.matrix(~ group)
  colnames(design) <- c("Intercept", "GroupEffect")

  # Fit limma model to obtain a ranking statistic (moderated t)
  fit  <- lmFit(expr_sub, design)
  fit  <- eBayes(fit)
  tt   <- topTable(fit, coef = "GroupEffect", number = Inf, sort.by = "none")

  # Build ranked vector (named by gene symbol) using moderated t-statistic
  ranks <- tt$t
  names(ranks) <- rownames(tt)
  ranks <- ranks[!is.na(ranks)]
  ranks <- sort(ranks, decreasing = TRUE)

  # Run fgsea
  set.seed(123)
  fgsea_res <- fgsea(
    pathways = pathways,
    stats    = ranks,
    minSize  = 10,
    maxSize  = 500
  )

  fgsea_res <- fgsea_res %>%
    arrange(padj) %>%
    as.data.frame()

  # Save full results (collapse leadingEdge for CSV export)
  fgsea_out <- fgsea_res
  fgsea_out$leadingEdge <- sapply(fgsea_out$leadingEdge,
                                  function(x) paste(x, collapse = ";"))
  write.csv(fgsea_out,
            file = file.path(gsea_dir, paste0(out_prefix, "_GSEA.csv")),
            row.names = FALSE)

  # Top 20 pathways by padj for plotting (LOLLIPOP version)
  top_paths <- fgsea_res %>%
    filter(!is.na(padj)) %>%
    slice_head(n = 20)

  if (nrow(top_paths) > 0) {
    p <- ggplot(top_paths,
                aes(x = NES, y = reorder(pathway, NES))) +
      geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = NES,
                       y = reorder(pathway, NES),
                       yend = reorder(pathway, NES)),
                   color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.4) +
      geom_point(aes(size = size, color = padj < 0.05)) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#9A32CD", "FALSE" = "grey70"),
                         name = "padj < 0.05") +
      scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 7), name = "Gene set size") +
      coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-3, 3)) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-3, 3, by = 1)) +
      labs(
        title = paste0("GSEA — ", contrast_label),
        subtitle = "Top 20 pathways by adjusted p-value",
        x = "Normalized Enrichment Score (NES)", y = NULL
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey95"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
      )
    print(p)
    
    ggsave(
      filename = file.path(gsea_dir, paste0(out_prefix, "_GSEA_top20.png")),
      plot     = p,
      width    = 10,
      height   = 7,
      dpi      = 300,
      bg       = "white"
    )
  }

  invisible(fgsea_res)
}

# ===========================
# Comparison 1: low vs (intermediate + high) — ALL patients
# ===========================
clin_c1 <- clin_gsea %>%
  mutate(group = ifelse(pSTAT3_cat == "low", "low", "int_high")) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("low", "int_high")))

res1 <- run_gsea_comparison(
  expr           = expr_mat_gsea,
  clin           = clin_c1,
  group_var      = "group",
  contrast_label = "low vs intermediate+high (all patients)",
  pathways       = pathways_list,
  out_prefix     = "C1_low_vs_intHigh_all"
)

# ===========================
# Comparison 2: low vs (intermediate + high) — PDL1+ only
# ===========================
clin_c2 <- clin_gsea %>%
  filter(PDL1 == 1) %>%
  mutate(group = ifelse(pSTAT3_cat == "low", "low", "int_high")) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("low", "int_high")))

res2 <- run_gsea_comparison(
  expr           = expr_mat_gsea,
  clin           = clin_c2,
  group_var      = "group",
  contrast_label = "low vs intermediate+high (PDL1+ only)",
  pathways       = pathways_list,
  out_prefix     = "C2_low_vs_intHigh_PDL1pos"
)

# ===========================
# Comparison 3: low vs high — ALL patients
# ===========================
clin_c3 <- clin_gsea %>%
  filter(pSTAT3_cat %in% c("low", "high")) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(pSTAT3_cat, levels = c("low", "high")))

res3 <- run_gsea_comparison(
  expr           = expr_mat_gsea,
  clin           = clin_c3,
  group_var      = "group",
  contrast_label = "pSTAT3-high vs pSTAT3-low (all patients)",
  pathways       = pathways_list,
  out_prefix     = "C3_low_vs_high_all"
)

# ===========================
# Comparison 4: low vs high — PDL1+ only
# ===========================
clin_c4 <- clin_gsea %>%
  filter(PDL1 == 1, pSTAT3_cat %in% c("low", "high")) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(pSTAT3_cat, levels = c("low", "high")))

res4 <- run_gsea_comparison(
  expr           = expr_mat_gsea,
  clin           = clin_c4,
  group_var      = "group",
  contrast_label = "low vs high (PDL1+ only)",
  pathways       = pathways_list,
  out_prefix     = "C4_low_vs_high_PDL1pos"
)

cat("\nGSEA analysis complete. Results saved in:\n", gsea_dir, "\n")
```
